title: Wet-room sockets without a residual-current device

mitigation.action: Electrician installs a residual-current device for the wet-room, sauna and outdoor socket circuits and tests it

known_quirks: Houses from before 1997 usually have no residual-current device on the bathroom and outdoor sockets unless the panel was renewed
A residual-current device trips at 30 milliamperes, below the current that stops the heart
Test the residual-current device with its test button every summer (Kunnon Koti summer to-do)
Ungrounded two-pin sockets in houses from before 1970 give no earth path at all; the device still protects the user
why_hint: DRAFT: The house is from before 1997, the bathroom has not been renovated since, and no electrician has checked the installation. Wet-room sockets of this age usually have no residual-current device.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: One small panel job protects the family from an electric shock in the bathroom, the sauna and the garden.
